title: Soft Silicone Cover With-Lip Balm
description:
The Rhode Lip Case is the ultimate blend of style and function – a sleek protective phone cover designed with a built-in slot for your favorite Rhode Peptide Lip Treatment. Perfect for beauty lovers on the go, it keeps your phone safe while making sure your lip balm is always within reach.
✨ Features:
• Designed to hold Rhode Peptide Lip Treatment securely
• Slim, protective cover for everyday use
• Available in multiple colors to match your vibe
• Sleek and minimal design with the Rhode aesthetic
• Compatible with various iPhone models
Pair it with any of the Rhode Lip Tint shades – Ribbon, Toast, Raspberry Jelly, PBJ, or Espresso– to keep your phone case as stylish as your lips.
